propose.description: Fisher proposes changes to fishery regulations

return_excess_catch.description: Fisher returns excess catch to the lake if over 0.75 kg.

collect_surplus.description: Elder collects and weighs Surplus Returned after each round.

decide_second_trips.description: Elder decides whether to authorize second trips based on stock.

invite_volunteers.description: Elder invites volunteers and allocates second trip permits.

distribute_surplus.description: Elder calculates each fisher's deficit and distributes surplus.

draw_from_reserve.description: Elder draws from Reserve Balance if surplus is insufficient.

order_contribution.description: Elder orders surplus catchers to donate or provide extra labor.

collect_penalties.description: Elder collects monetary penalties and updates communal pot.

vote_disbursements.description: Council votes on communal pot disbursements.

convene_meeting.description: Elder convenes meeting and community votes on penalties for violations.

vote_penalties.description: Council votes on penalties for violations.

fisher.description: eligibility to act as a fisher

elder.description: most senior fisher elected by unanimous vote daily

scribe.description: chosen by simple majority vote of active fishers each season

calculate_remaining_stock.description: Calculate Remaining Lake Stock: (total catch weight) / (standard volume-area)

quorum_rule.description: Quorum for council decisions requires all active fishers, elder, and scribe present.

net_scale.description: Calibrated net-scale for catch measurement; shared among fishers, displays weight immediately after setting the net.

ledger.description: Ledger recording all fishery activities and distributions.

reserve_balance.description: Reserve Balance pool of fish held in trust.
